TREATMENT In mild hypermagnesemia, discontinuation of 
medications containing magnesium is warranted. Calcium glu-
conate, given intravenously, can reverse eﬀ ects of magnesium
in more severe cases. Dialysis can also be used to decrease high
levels of magnesium.
